resolution.question: Will doctoral candidate Femi Adeyemi and his three committee members converge on a defense date inside the department's November window within the next ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-09-24T17:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that all four parties (Femi and the three committee members) have explicitly agreed on a specific defense date that falls within the department's November window. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
